name: interactive-morphing-play-pause-button
title: Interactive "Morphing" Play/Pause Button
description: Interactive "Morphing" Play/Pause Button - Créé par @anonymous sur TailwindFlex.
author: @anonymous (TailwindFlex)

meta.author: @anonymous
meta.rawHtml:
<button id="playPauseButton" class="relative bg-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-600 p-4 rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out transform hover:scale-105 focus:outline-none focus:ring-4 focus:ring-blue-300">
    <svg id="playPauseIcon" class="w-6 h-6 text-white pointer-events-none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor">
        <path d="M8 5v14l11-7z" />
    </svg>
</button>

<script>
  const button = document.getElementById('playPauseButton');
    const icon = document.getElementById('playPauseIcon');
    let isPlaying = false;

    button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        isPlaying = !isPlaying;
        if (isPlaying) {
            icon.style.animation = 'playToPause 0.3s forwards';
        } else {
            icon.style.animation = 'pauseToPlay 0.3s forwards';
        }
    });
</script>
